summary: The close asks everyone to get to work.
realLife: Four of six governors read closed with a call to work together or get to work: Michigan, Wisconsin, Colorado, and Tennessee's pursuing it with the legislators.
sources: Read Nov 24, 2026 as the as-prepared text from the governor's page or a news mirror (extract of the opening and close); the middles were not read.
inGame: The send-off lines are plain next steps; needs: a send-off that names the legislature and asks it to work.

turns.what: The close says the governor will go it alone.
turns.pulledBy: a competitive speaker; the other party holds the body
